promotion_note: PROMOTED 2026-08-11 (ercot-188) BY EXPLICIT OWNER DECISION — the signable open-ruling board, card E, option E2 ('promote on the standing structural standard'), taken AGAINST this session's own recommendation of E1 (do not promote) and against the mechanical verdict. *** THE PRE-REGISTERED MECHANICAL VERDICT IS REJECTED-AS-ARMED AND IS NOT REWRITTEN: G-C3c FAILS (2023 model tail 61 -> 58 against an actual 181, i.e. 3 h FURTHER from actual). The promotion is the owner's standing structural standard applied ON TOP of that verdict, not a re-scoring of it. *** WHAT IT IS: the ercot185 recipe plus ONE mechanism delta, ercot_econ_curve_top_refine=true — SCHEME R1 of the (c2) cliff-resolving offer-curve refinement, itself built under the OWNER'S option (B) BUILD ANYWAY on the MEMO-ercot184 §8 card over that memo's own recommendation to CLOSE. offer_curves._econ_curve_steps cut each plant's econ ramp into offer_curve_smoothing_n = 6 EQUAL-WIDTH MW blocks, so the finest within-plant position the model could express was 1/6 of the ramp — a supply-curve top that CANNOT express a cliff, while reality's marginal price forms inside the top 0.24 % of the marginal resource's own submitted curve (q_act p50 0.9976, ercot-180). Armed, the ramp's TOP block is re-sliced n ways with the body's n-1 blocks left expression-for-expression identical (2n-1 = 11 slices, top sliver 2.778 % of the ramp). ZERO NEW SCALARS (rule 23): the split point is 1 - 1/n, the boundary the ramp is ALREADY sliced at, and the sub-slice count is the same n — both the registered offer_curve_smoothing_n — so the shape FOLLOWS n and the DOF ledger is the prior keeper's, verbatim. *** WHAT IT BUYS, AND IT IS REPRESENTATIONAL ONLY: econ rows in the measured top decile go 33 -> 382, quoting up to 145x delivered gas, with capacity conserved to 1.5e-11 MW. THE MODEL CAN NOW EXPRESS A CLIFF; IT STILL DOES NOT CLEAR ON ONE — item 23's conclusion reproduced from the opposite direction by a real LP. *** MEASURED OUTCOME, AT FULL MAGNITUDE AND IN THE WRONG DIRECTION: C3a-2023 -32.5 % -> -32.8 % ($43.44 -> $43.23 against an actual $64.32), i.e. -$0.21/MWh; C3b-2023 0.602 -> 0.608. Per-year C3a deltas -0.21 / -0.08 / -0.03 $/MWh — uniformly slightly negative, so no in-sample gain was bought with held-out degradation. ercot-184's invariant-quantity mirror had put R1's ceiling at +$1.99/MWh; the real LP delivered a SIGN FLIP, inside the precommit's pre-registered reconciliation band [-$1.00, +$4.00] so no STOP fired. C3b-2024 improves marginally 0.160 -> 0.158. DETERMINATION NOT-YET, fail set {C3a-2023, C3b-2023} — UNCHANGED. *** GATES: PASS G-SHED (4/2/0 -> 4/2/0; the ercot-48/49 manufactured-shortage falsifier has killed this object twice and missed cleanly here at SOLVE grain, corroborating MEMO §4.6's build-free zero-shed-exposure result), G-OWNER (C3a-2024 keeps PASS +1.4 -> +1.2 %; C3b-2024 under 0.20; C3a-2025 -8.0 % vs the -9.1 % bound), G-SPUR (10->9, 11->11, 1->1), G-COAL148 (max rise -0.0 TWh vs the 0.5 bar), G-DOF (zero new scalars), G-COST (LP columns x1.295, UNDER the memo's x1.39 estimate; peak RSS 12.71 vs the control's 10.20 GB, inside the box, no year dropped). FAIL G-C3c, stated above. LOYO: parameter-free rule, so leave-one-year-out is N/A and per-year deltas stand in its place (ercot-173 precedent). *** SEAM PROOF ALL_ASSERTIONS_PASS (ercot188_topfine_seamproof.json): SP-1 gate-off byte-identical to pre-edit HEAD x3 years; SP-2 — the charter's mandatory cross-ISO assertion — all five non-ERCOT ISOs BYTE-IDENTICAL with the gate ARMED, each reconstructed from its own committed bundle and each carrying real econc rows (CAISO 128 / PJM 227 / NYISO 45 / NEISO 38 / MISO 147 plant-groups, so not vacuous); SP-3 fleet MW deviation 1.5e-11; SP-3b CHP steam floor redistributed, never created or destroyed; SP-4 body byte-identical in cap AND heat rate; SP-5 slice counts exactly {6, 11}; SP-6 committed band unrefined; SP-7 pinned default cache key 603c2498bf71d21d UNMOVED, armed key 613cd5243fd84f20 distinct. AMENDMENT 1 (pre-solve): the pre-registered falsifier CAUGHT A REAL DEFECT — the first build hit the assembly's pre-existing 0.5 MW tranche floor and DELETED 40.27 MW/yr from 36 of 144 plant-groups; the guard applies R1 only where every sub-slice clears that floor (108/144 groups = 99.331 % of econ MW), adds no parameter and substitutes no scheme. *** THE NAMED PERMANENT LIMITATION THIS KEEPER CARRIES, AND IT DOES NOT EXPIRE: this is the FIRST offer-side ERCOT mechanism since ERCOT-86 that does NOT ride the P1-only mc_bid_adjust seam. The slicer writes heat rates into the BASE fleet, i.e. into the P0 objective, so it BREACHES that seam and PERMANENTLY FORFEITS the offer-surface family's P0 bit-identity proof. Every control-vs-arm difference on this keeper is confounded with commitment-side motion, so a mechanism can be isolated here only by ARGUMENT, never by proof — the ercot-181 seam proof's byte-identity assertions have no analogue. Measured: 73 of 132 committed rows (12,474 MW) carry a different P0 commitment pattern, and the gas commitment bridge's floored unit-hours move in all three years (12,375->12,309 / 6,164->6,160 / 13,326->13,287). WHAT THE P0 DECOMPOSITION DOES NOT SUPPORT, AND IS NOT CLAIMED: P0 energy is conserved to 2.8e-05 TWh on 303 TWh and the start-amortization arithmetic is two orders of magnitude too small to carry the annual price move; NOTHING apportions the residual between the ladder and commitment channels, because no counterfactual separates them — they are the same code change. That inability IS the forfeited proof, measured rather than predicted. *** COST ACCEPTED BY THE OWNER: x1.295 LP columns on a keeper whose added 540 rows are measured never to be cleared on.
